standard: Every action benefiting a named private party (contracts, purchases, renewals, change orders, piggybacks, zoning/land use/variances/plats/site plans/development agreements, leases and sales of public land, grants and fee waivers to named organizations, settlements, easements, licenses). Excludes proclamations, ceremonial items, appointments, internal staffing, government-only items. Built without reference to donors.

gaps.issue: Granicus posts minutes for only 12 of the 2025-2026 meetings (2025-01-14 regular and LPA, 2025-02-11, 2025-03-18, 2025-04-08, 2025-05-13 regular and LPA, 2025-06-10, 2025-07-01, 2026-02-10, 2026-04-14, 2026-05-14). Minutes are not included in later agenda packets. Every other council meeting from 2025-08-19 through 2026-10-13, and the 2025-01-28 special meeting, is agenda-only; their private-party agenda items are listed with roll null
Several minutes PDFs are scans with OCR noise; rolls were read from the "voting Yes / voting No" lists and checked by hand for split votes
Councilmember Bracken recused himself on the 12-22-24 Crandon Boulevard site plan; he is marked absent in that roll
Applicants or owners are not named in titles for the variances at 920 Mariner Drive and 640 South Mashta Drive, or for the 101 Harbor Drive rezoning
Workshops (infrastructure, undergrounding, shoreline, swale, budget, Zone 1) take no votes and are not listed

Excluded under the standard: FDEP, FEMA, NOAA, FIND, UASI and county grant and interlocal items, School Board joint use, Supervisor of Elections polling agreement, police union contracts, code amendments and budgets
